definitions.explanation: One of Japan's major national daily newspapers, founded in Osaka in 1879 and now published from Tokyo and Osaka. It is generally regarded as center-left.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{朝日新聞|あさひしんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいる→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: My father reads the Asahi Shimbun every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{朝日新聞|あさひしんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{載|の}った。
examples.english: The article ran on the front page of the Asahi Shimbun.

examples.japanese: {朝日新聞|あさひしんぶん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{読売新聞|よみうりしんぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{扱|あつか}い{方|かた}→扱い方：21915_atsukaikata⟧がかなり⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The Asahi and the Yomiuri often treat the same event quite differently.

notes:
Often shortened to ⟦{朝日|あさひ}→朝日：23495_asahi⟧: ⟦{朝日|あさひ}→朝日：23495_asahi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社説|しゃせつ}→社説：04197_shasetsu⟧ (the Asahi's editorial). Not to be confused with the brewer アサヒ (Asahi Breweries) or the broadcaster ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦{朝日|あさひ}→朝日：23495_asahi⟧, which is part of the same media group.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {朝日新聞|あさひしんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社説|しゃせつ}→社説：04197_shasetsu⟧: an Asahi editorial
- {天声人語|てんせいじんご}: the paper's front-page column, long used as reading practice for entrance exams

RELATED WORDS:
- {読売新聞|よみうりしんぶん}: Yomiuri Shimbun, the largest national daily, generally regarded as conservative
- ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧: newspaper
